2609.22039.title: Gricea: An Open Science Platform for Conversational AI Research
2609.22039.paper_summary: We need studies on conversational AI (CAI) at scale to understand human behavior and shape CAI design. However, fragmented reporting of systems and study configurations hinders replication, extension, and knowledge accumulation. We present Gricea, an open-science platform representing studies as configurable, deployable research artifacts that researchers can run, inspect, share, and reuse. Informed by a formative analysis of prior CAI research, Gricea couples study procedures, participant-facing systems, and conversational task behavior in. In a replication study using Gricea, we replicated configurations 93% of eligible CUI 2026 papers; while also flagging missing information in 96% of papers that hinder faithful replication --- further motivating Gricea's need. In a user study, researchers and practitioners from diverse backgrounds successfully constructed runnable studies addressing various open-ended research questions. Together, these findings demonstrate Gricea's support for constructing, reproducing, and extending CAI studies through shared research artifacts, enabling cumulative knowledge building through open science.
2609.22039.paper_summary_zh: 我們需要對大規模的對話式人工智慧（CAI）進行研究，以了解人類行為並塑造CAI設計。<lb/>然而，系統和研究配置的片段化報告妨礙了複製、擴展和知識積累。<lb/>我們提出了Gricea，一個開放科學平台，將研究表示為可配置、可部署的研究工件，研究人員可以運行、檢查、分享和重用。<lb/>根據對先前CAI研究的形成性分析，Gricea將研究程序、面向參與者的系統和對話任務行為結合在一起。<lb/>在使用Gricea的複製研究中，我們複製了93%的符合條件的CUI 2026論文配置；同時也標記了96%論文中缺失的信息，這妨礙了忠實的複製——進一步促進了Gricea的必要性。<lb/>在一項用戶研究中，來自不同背景的研究人員和實踐者成功構建了可運行的研究，解決了各種開放式研究問題。<lb/>這些發現共同證明了Gricea在通過共享研究工件來構建、重現和擴展CAI研究方面的支持，促進了通過開放科學進行累積知識的建立。
